a_feature_should_remove_real_friction_cl: UN función should quitar real friction, clarify un decision o make datos more reliable.
a_product_foundation_not_an_exaggerated_: UN product foundation, no un exaggerated promise
every_entry_should_explain_work_decision: Cada entrada should explain work, decisions y growth, no solo confirmar attendance.
forms_charts_modals_and_filters_are_desi: Forms, charts, modals y filtros son designed para mobile, tablet y desktop instead de patched later.
internship_information_is_often_scattere: Práctica information es often scattered across timesheets, centro educativo documents, personal notas, screenshots y memories. Este fragmentation makes progreso hard a see y informes difficult a prepare.
local_mode_works_without_an_account_expo: Local mode works sin un cuenta, exports stay disponible y nube sincronización remains opcional.
make_internships_measurable_presentable_: Make prácticas measurable, presentable y genuinely educational.
practicora_brings_these_elements_into_a_: Practicora brings these elements into un calm, structured espacio de trabajo. El objetivo es no a añadir administración, but a turn un few minutes de regular documentation into un reliable profesional historial.
practicora_is_first_designed_for_student: Practicora es primero designed para estudiantes y interns who want reliable datos, clearer progreso y better informes. El same structure puede later soporte supervisor meetings, programa assessments y portfolio preparation.
practicora_is_the_working_name_used_for_: Practicora es el working nombre used para este nuevo version. Antes de public commercialization, el nombre, trademarks y domains debe undergo completar legal y commercial clearance.
practicora_starts_from_a_simple_idea_a_s: Practicora starts desde un simple idea: un estudiante should no have a reconstruct months de work when writing un informe o preparing para un interview.
the_current_version_is_a_functional_saas: El actual version es un functional SaaS foundation: indexable public site, private app, local datos, Supabase integration, authentication, exports, responsive diseño y analítica. Future institucional funciones debe ser validated con real programas antes de being presented as disponible.
the_student_remains_central_while_the_st: El estudiante remains central, while el structure also supports informes, supervisor discussions y future institucional needs.
transitions_remain_short_and_subtle_they: Transitions remain short y subtle. They communicate state changes sin slowing work.
metadata_description: Discover Practicora’s mission, product principles y vision para more reliable y educational práctica tracking.
